name: GA_Long_Context_Jailbreak_Benchmark
description:
GA Long Context Bench
	

A benchmark of 1500 multi-turn conversations designed to stress guardrails in long contexts. Each dialog pairs a serialized agent trace with optional prompt injections or per-policy adjudications. Half of the rows embed malicious content deep inside long instructions, enabling evaluation of long-context systems.
Accompanying guardrail releases: GA Guard Core and GA Guard Lite. Check out public benchmarks and results in our blogpost.
